_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Leg is flat with neutral funding and mid fear-greed; no volatility or flow breaker has printed, so the statistically honest coil call is hold at the current rung.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both sit on Complacency now; analyst explicitly forwards HOLD/Complacency, narrative offers no directional forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound, fear-greed stays mid-40s to low-60s, ETF flows stay dead, no vol break
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with clear upside momentum break, or crowded longs unwind with fear-greed under 40 and range failure
